document.title: Section 5 in The Hindu Women's Rights To Property Act, 1937

raw_text:
Section 5 in The Hindu Women's Rights To Property Act, 1937

source

Union of India - Section

5. Meaning of expression die intestate

.For the purpose of this Act a person shall be deemed to die intestate in respect of all property of which he has not made a testamentary disposition which is capable of taking effect.
